verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents a soft `ttl` that automatically pauses a sandbox on expiry and can be refreshed while work continues, so it lapses when idle. A `hard_ttl` deletes the sandbox and its RootFS state. Paused sandboxes incur no compute charges, only storage, under per-second billing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that timeouts trigger reliably, and automatic idle detection (idleness depends on the client no longer refreshing the TTL).
